theorems.name: Submission.smr_ufd_ball_tietze
theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (C : Set (Eucl P)) (u : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), IsClosed C → ContinuousOn u C → (∀ x ∈ C, ‖u x‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ w : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), Continuous w ∧ (∀ x, ‖w x‖ ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ x ∈ C, w x = u x
